description:
## What changed

Hide feed surveys no longer empties the profile's Favorites tab. TikTok gives the Favorites page the same view id as the feed survey card, and Hushfeed's overlay hider took every view with that id anywhere in the window, so with that switch on the tab opened to nothing. Feed furniture (the caption, the music block, the action column, the survey card, the rail buttons and their counts) is now hidden only inside a feed cell, and the tab strip is unchanged. On a build that renames the cell root the hider falls back to the whole window and the diagnostic report names the miss.

This was found on a Galaxy S25 by restoring the settings one group at a time, then one switch at a time, and the fix was checked on the same phone with the same settings.

Two smaller changes in the Feature Gate Lab. Its switch rows (Enable overrides, and the Override and Forced result rows on a gate's page) are one screen-reader stop each with the Switch role, and the whole row toggles the switch; they used to read twice and only answer a tap on the switch itself. An import that accepted something reports in a dialog, one line per count with the first rejection selectable and Undo beside Done, instead of a five-clause toast.

## Validation

1,362 runtime tests and 203 patch tests passed locally with no failures, errors or skips, and both Android API level checks passed. The bundle carries 81 patches with all three DEX payloads non-empty, and every patch applied with zero failures to the 46.2.3, 46.7.3 and 46.8.3 fixtures; the receipt beside this release records each verdict. Needs Morphe Manager 1.30.0 or newer.

On a Galaxy S25 running 0.34.0 with Hide feed surveys on, the Favorites tab opened to nothing, and TikTok's own view tree showed the tab's page hidden under the survey card's id. The same phone, patched with this build through Morphe Manager and with the same settings restored, shows the tab with its saved posts.
